cases.question: Can you pray without wuduu?

selectedEvidence.text: Allah commanded performing Wudu for prayer. This is a command of obligation in the case of impurity, and in the case of purity it is merely a recommendation; the Prophet prayed five prayers with one Wudu.

cases.generatedAnswer: Wudu is obligatory in a state of impurity but merely recommended when already pure. [S1]

expected.sourceDerivedOracle: The evidence distinguishes needing Wudu after impurity from not needing to renew an existing still-valid Wudu for every prayer. The answer must make that distinction clear without relying on outside knowledge.

cases.question: Is night prayer obligatory?

selectedEvidence.text: Standing at night was obligatory at the beginning of the Surah. Allah later lightened this burden, and night prayer became voluntary after it had been obligatory.

cases.generatedAnswer: Standing for night prayer was obligatory. [S1]

expected.sourceDerivedOracle: The answer must preserve the evidence's temporal distinction: initially obligatory, later made voluntary.
